governmentServices.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
governmentServices.description: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for pre-matric, post-matric, and merit-based national scholarships for recognized colleges and universities.
benefits: 100% course tuition fee waiver directly to verified institution
Maintenance allowance up to ₹50,000/year for hostellers
Special incentives for STEM and girl students
eligibility: Enrolled in a recognized school, college, or university
Minimum 50% marks in previous qualifying examination

governmentServices.name: Driving Licence & Learner's Licence (Sarathi)
governmentServices.ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
governmentServices.description: Application for Learner's Licence, Permanent Driving Licence, slot booking, address renewal, and digital mParivahan credential integration.
benefits: Home-based online computer test for Learner's Licence
QR-coded digital Smart Card Driving Licence
Instant nationwide validity under Motor Vehicles Act
eligibility: Minimum 18 years of age (16 for gearless two-wheelers)

governmentServices.name: Annual Income Certificate Issuance
governmentServices.description: Statutory certificate issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer / Tahsildar certifying total annual household income for education concessions and welfare.
benefits: Essential prerequisite for fee concessions, scholarships, and EWS quota
Valid across all state higher education institutions and welfare schemes
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra with verified local residential record
Submitted self-declaration and employer salary slip or agricultural revenue slip

governmentServices.name: State Domicile & Age-Nationality Certificate
governmentServices.description: Official statutory certificate proving continuous residency in the state for 15+ years, essential for government job quotas and college admissions.
benefits: State quota reservation in professional engineering & medical colleges
Eligibility for State Public Service Commission (MPSC) examinations
eligibility: Continuous residence in Maharashtra for minimum 15 years
Proof of residence or school attendance within the state

governmentServices.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
governmentServices.description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 transferred directly into bank accounts of landholding farmer families.
benefits: ₹6,000 annual direct cash transfer via Aadhaar DBT
Seamless integration with Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding
Active Aadhaar e-KYC and land records seeding

governmentServices.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Coverage
governmentServices.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
governmentServices.description: Secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalisation cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empanelled hospitals.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services up to ₹5 Lakhs/year
Covers pre-existing conditions from day one
eligibility: Families identified in Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) or state welfare list
